metadata.title: A Note on the Schouten--Nijenhuis Bracket of Lie--Rinehart Algebras
authors: Servais Cyr Gatsé \and Basile Guy Richard Bossoto \and Irmely Gladesh Mabanza Nsiloulou
metadata.abstract: Let $A$ be a commutative associative unital algebra over a field $K$ of characteristic zero, and let $(G,\rho)$ be a Lie--Rinehart algebra over $A$. We revisit the Gerstenhaber structure carried by the exterior algebra $\bigwedge_A G$ from the point of view of graded derivations. Particular attention is paid to the well-definedness of the Schouten--Nijenhuis extension over the coefficient algebra $A$: the Lie--Rinehart identity is shown to provide exactly the correction terms needed for the bracket to descend to the $A$-balanced exterior algebra. After establishing graded antisymmetry, the Leibniz rule and the graded Jacobi identity without circularity, we study the inner graded derivations $\adSN(P)=[P,\cdot]_{SN}$ and prove \[ [\adSN(P),\adSN(Q)]=\adSN([P,Q]_{SN}). \] Finally, we give a complete proof of the converse construction: Gerstenhaber brackets on $\bigwedge_A G$ are in one-to-one correspondence with Lie--Rinehart structures on $G$.

analysis.workSummary: 从分次导子出发重述 Lie–Rinehart 外代数上的 Schouten–Nijenhuis 括号，验证其在 A 平衡关系上的良定义，并证明与 Gerstenhaber 结构的反向对应。
analysis.breakthrough: 给出避免循环论证的基础构造及内导子交换公式。
analysis.limitations: 侧重经典结构的证明整理，摘要未提出新的几何分类。 当前为摘要级数学解读；AI 披露另行做独立全文核查，尚未核验的记录不代表未使用 AI。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。

analysis.priorityReason: 主要作为括号运算与代数基础的参考材料。
analysis.lowPriorityReason: 主要作为括号运算与代数基础的参考材料。 当前优先安排与曲率、极限空间和几何 PDE 更直接相关的论文。
